notes.title: v0.4.4
notes.content:
Added aggression to AI based on a win streak
 Added charge attack to AI 
 Tweaks to player difficulty, damage and bojo, and bongslugger
 A new face bandage item added
 New song added
 Tweaked camera zoom
 Fixed Void level not filling screen correctly
 Charge attack can be interrupted

notes.title: v0.4.3
notes.content:
Mainly balancing


 Player damage
 Player speed
 Bojo and BongSlugger health and ability settings

notes.title: v0.4.2.1
notes.content: Added new borders for both desert maps

notes.title: v0.4.2
notes.content:
Thanks to some great feedback from active testers, I introduced an agression system for AI enemies. This is a secret recipe in terms of its inner workings but the impact can be felt immediately when playing this latest version.
 

 Camera rework makes it more snappy and camera zoom is tuned for a more attacking fighting style.
 Player speed increased, this is also for quicker attacks.
 New AI aggression system in place, will still be iterated over going forward.

notes.title: v0.4.0.1

notes.title: v0.3.9
notes.content:
New ability types called wearables have been added to the system

Changes

 One new wearable ability called the "Sexy Nurse Hat" has been added
 Disabled all levels besides Britain, as the focus is to test stage completion and check if the balance is correct.
 New abilities can be added via updates without the need for wipes.


This update also includes some minor bug fixes

notes.title: v0.3.8
notes.content:
NEW FEATURE

 Added ability upgrades, when you use an ability and you win rounds your ability will increment until an upgrade is available for it. You can then purchase the upgrade.


BUG FIXES

 Fixed minor bug switching between abilities in UI
